Practical notes

  • Getting around: get an Istanbulkart (metro, tram, ferries, funicular). Your hotel is a downhill walk from Kabataş (T1 tram to Sultanahmet). Taxis are fine for the walls and Balat.
  • Weather & light: early November is mild but can be rainy; pack layers and a light rain jacket. Sunset is around 17:00, so plan outdoor areas for the afternoon.
  • Mosque etiquette: covered shoulders and knees; scarf for women; shoes off. Mosques pause visitors during the five daily prayers, and around Friday midday prayer.
  • Tickets (2026 guide prices, verify): Hagia Sophia about €25 for foreign visitors and not covered by the Museum Pass. The Museum Pass covers Topkapı, the Archaeological Museums and Chora’s museum section; compare it with paying per entry for only two or three sites.
  • Closures: Topkapı is closed Tuesdays, and Yedikule Fortress is closed Mondays. The Grand Bazaar is closed Sundays, so Saturday is its day.
  • Going home: your flight KM 785 leaves 11:35 on Tue 10 Nov. Book the hotel transfer back (the hotel lists a 24-hour airport shuttle) and leave at 07:45, which gets you to the airport about 3 hours ahead.
  • Hours change: please double-check hours and prices close to the date, as holidays and seasonal schedules shift.
